reviews.title: Hijackers!
reviews.text: After getting bombarded with ads, now they add loud music to the background so you can’t meditate and need to upgrade.  I did once and after paying for premium, they still hit me up with more charges.  These guys are awful

reviews.title: Exactly what I wanted
reviews.text: Just right for me. I can choose all my own timings: it’s all very straightforward and stays in the background with gentle reminders for each stage i choose.

reviews.title: Just okay if it were free
reviews.text: It’d be okay for a free meditation timer - if it were free. Allows interval bells, but only one interval time for each meditation you set up. No irregular intervals. If you want to time different practices of different lengths in a single meditation session, look elsewhere.

reviews.title: Strange pricing
reviews.text: I paid few dollars one-time for this timer app. Now they come and change it to a subscription model and ask more money per year. This is a trivial app which any AI engine can create in hours. Asking for subscription does not look right

reviews.title: Confusing and too limited
reviews.text: There are some things I like about the timer, but I cannot seem to make the timing work as I need it to and it would be helpful to be able to record a reminder for multi part meditations
